artworks.title: Standard Bearer
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 5.8 × 8.4 cm (2 5/16 × 3 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure holding a large sword-like object, standing against a backdrop of chaos. The drawing depicts a figure from the back, holding what appears to be a massive sword or banner with an elaborate handle or decorative end, seemingly engaging with an unseen opponent. The foreground is filled with dynamic lines that suggest movement and action. The details include numerous smaller figures or shapes running around in the background amid what appears to be tall grass or reeds. The artistic style involves strong linear elements and a high contrast typical of woodcuts or engravings.

artworks.title: Skirmish in a Roman Circus
artworks.description: This is a print of a battle scene within a large amphitheater, with numerous people engaging in combat. Closest to us, a person wearing flowing robes has their arms raised and their face in an expression of distress, their eyes wide and their mouth open. Other people are scattered throughout the arena, each involved in combat or fallen on the ground, many with exaggerated expressions and gestures. The amphitheater features towering columns with tiers of seats in the background.

artworks.title: Piazza SS. Annunziata, Florence
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated view looking over a busy plaza. A bearded man with a staff stands in the foreground, overlooking the bustling scene below. In the distance, an equestrian statue sits atop a pedestal at the center of the plaza. Various figures are engaged in activities around the statue. An arcaded building with a dome and spire can be seen on the horizon. The etching is monochromatic with detailed lines defining the figures, buildings, and environment. The style features sharp, detailed strokes conveying movement and liveliness in the marketplace setting.

artworks.title: Fireworks on the Arno, Florence
artworks.description: The image shows an intricate etching depicting a busy scene with numerous small figures engaged in various activities. The upper third features a detailed bridge with multiple arches spanning the horizon. Beyond the bridge, there is a cluster of detailed buildings resembling a cityscape with towers and domed structures. The illustration uses precise, thin lines to depict texture and detail in both the buildings and the crowd below. The color scheme is monochromatic, with sepia tones creating depth. In the foreground, individuals participate in daily activities alongside horse-drawn carts, while the river and cityscape in the distance form a lively background.

artworks.title: Piazza della Signoria, Florence
artworks.description: The image is an engraving depicting a busy town square from a bird's-eye view. In the foreground, there is a figure with an intricate hat and clothing pointing forward. The square is filled with detailed figures of people and horses going about various activities. Tall buildings frame the composition, leading the eye towards the horizon where a tower is visible. The engraving features fine linework, creating texture and depth. The color scheme is monochromatic, with black ink on light parchment, highlighting the detailed craftsmanship of the lines and giving a historical tone to the image.

artworks.title: Piazza del Duomo, Florence
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated view of a figure standing on a rooftop or balcony looking over a populated square. The square is crowded with small figures engaged in various activities. In the distance, there are hills, buildings, a tall tower with a flag, and a large domed building. The scene is depicted in monochrome with fine, linear brushstrokes, giving it a detailed and lively feel.

artworks.title: Piazza Santa Maria Novella, Florence
artworks.description: The image shows a bird's-eye view of a busy scene. A large figure dressed in period attire, wearing a cape and hat, stands on the left side. The horizon is positioned above the center with a cityscape of buildings. In an open space, small figures are engaged in various activities with vehicles in motion. The buildings are detailed with fine lines, and figures and objects in the foreground are depicted with simpler outlines. The color palette is black and white, creating high contrast.

artworks.title: Piazza Presso alla Porta al Prato
artworks.description: The image shows a wide aerial view of a public gathering. Buildings line the horizon overlooking the scene below. The detailed illustration features various individuals and animals in motion, including groups of people, horse riders, and carts. The monochromatic color palette contributes to a classic aesthetic.

artworks.title: Piazza Santa Croce, Florence
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a city square. A central figure dressed in a costume with a drum is in the foreground. In the background, there are various activities happening, including running and feasting, with structures and carts around. The buildings have detailed engravings, suggesting a historical setting. Bold lines show scale and activity, depicting a lively atmosphere in the city square.

artworks.title: Frontispiece for Callot's "The Penitents"
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate plaque with text. The central focus of the image is a plaque that bears the text "Les Penitents et Penitentes par Jacques Callot". The plaque is adorned with elaborately curved designs reminiscent of Baroque architecture, featuring a masked figure and two burning urns flanking the top. At the bottom of the plaque, the words "Avec Privilege du Roy" are inscribed, along with "Israel ex."

artworks.title: Jacques Callot
artworks.description: The image shows a historical portrait of a man. He has a moustache, a pointed beard, wavy hair, and is wearing a high-collared shirt with decorative buttons. A medallion is visible around his neck. The portrait is set within an ornate oval frame with leaf or feather designs. There are additional ornamental details, including an emblem with three stars, Latin inscriptions, and decorative motifs in the background.

artworks.title: Jacques Callot
artworks.artist: Lucas Emil Vorsterman after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated, facing slightly to the viewer's right with a stern expression. He has high cheekbones, a sharp nose, shoulder-length wavy hair, a mustache, and a goatee. He wears a collared shirt with lacework and a doublet with buttons, and holds a narrow tool or pencil in his right hand resting on papers on the table before him. Various drawing tools and items, including a compass, are on the table. The background features parallel hatching lines.

artworks.title: Bohemians
artworks.description: Three individuals are shown in full length. The person on the left is sitting, with a large, rounded hat and long, flowing hair. They are reaching out with one hand to the middle person. This seated individual is clothed in a long, draped garment. The middle person is standing and appears to be performing some form of gesture with their hands towards the seated person, wearing a hood and a long cloak, with long hair visible. The third person is on the right, standing, holding a child and wearing a cap, with facial features partially visible, dressed in a long, striped garment. The background consists of a few simplistic buildings and trees.

artworks.title: Pantaloons
artworks.description: This drawing features six tall, lanky figures in theatrical attire. Each figure has a distinct costume suggesting a performance or masquerade theme. The intricate line work captures a sense of movement and depth. In the background, there is a cityscape, adding context to the scene. The drawing combines realism with playful exaggeration in its portrayal of the figures.

artworks.title: The Virgin at the Column (La Vierge à la colonne)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of ornate religious iconography. The drawing features a intricately designed frame with a crowned figure holding a child. The figures are positioned within an arched frame surrounded by elaborate scrollwork and geometric patterns. The drawing uses hatching and cross-hatching techniques for depth and texture, enhancing the decorative border. An inscription below the figures references "S. MARIA AD COLUMNAM in Bas. S. Petri Roma," potentially linking to religious works associated with the Basilica of Saint Peter in Rome. The style presents a blend of religious iconography and ornamental art.

artworks.title: Salvator Mundi
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing in a frontal pose with his right hand extended outward and his left hand holding a draped garment. The man has a long face with a prominent nose, long wavy hair, and is dressed in a flowing robe. A halo of rays emanates from his head. The background has a pattern of thin lines and at the bottom of the image, the text "SALVATOR MVNDI SALVA NOS" is inscribed.

artworks.title: Boniface VIII with Saints Francis and Crispin Adoring the Virgin and Child
artworks.description: The artwork features five individuals in various poses. At the top center, a woman sits on a swirling cloud with a child on her lap, both adorned with halos. Surrounding them are smaller winged cherubs integrated with clouds. Below, on the left, stands a barefoot, bearded older man looking upwards, while on the right, an older man in religious robes stands with clasped hands. In the foreground, a figure dressed in ornate robes kneels facing the woman and child, wearing a papal-like tiara with hands pressed together in prayer. The background shows an undulating landscape.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Virgin and Child
artworks.description: The image displays a group of full-body figures in a composed arrangement. At the top, two angels are depicted, each on either side of a rectangular framed image showing a woman holding a child, both with halos above their heads. The angels have detailed wings and are adorned in flowing garments. Below, a group of kneeling figures, primarily women, are shown in profile. They wear long, draped robes and have delicate, serene facial features with smooth, flowing hairstyles. Some of the figures hold palm branches, and one figure holds the image of a child. The background is filled with clouds, and additional smaller cherubic faces are embedded among the clouds. The intricate lines and use of shading across the composition contribute to the depth and texture of the overall scene.

artworks.title: Virgin and Saint John at the Foot of the Cross
artworks.description: The image shows the crucified figure of Jesus Christ, depicted from the knees up, with his arms outstretched and nailed to a wooden cross. He has a crown of thorns on his head, long hair and a beard, and wears a loincloth around his waist. To his left is a woman, likely representing the Virgin Mary, wearing a long robe and a head veil. She has a contemplative expression and clasped hands, looking toward Jesus. To his right is another woman in a similar attire, looking up at Jesus with a contemplative expression. Both women have circular halos around their heads. The background is minimalist with line shading.

artworks.title: Lamentation
artworks.description: The image depicts three figures within an architectural frame resembling a window or niche, supported by two columns. The central figure is shown from the upper thighs up, seated or resting with a slightly forward lean. This person has long, wavy hair and a beard, with closed eyes, and appears to be unclothed save for a cloth draped around the lower body. On either side of the central figure are two other individuals, shown from the waist up. The figure on the left has a veiled head and is turned towards the center. The figure on the right is similarly engaged, with shoulder-length hair and appears to be supporting or touching the central figure's arm. Both side figures are clad in draped robes. The image is monochromatic and has a textured background behind the figures, with the columns and architectural elements adding a sense of depth and structure to the scene.

artworks.title: Pietà
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a sculpture. It features a seated figure holding another figure. The scene includes a backdrop of a large cross with a crown symbol at its apex. The figures show intricate cross-hatching and shading to emphasize drapery folds and contours. The lines are detailed, creating a contrast between light and shadow. The figures rest upon a plinth with engraved text.

artworks.title: Immaculate Conception
artworks.description: The image shows a woman holding a child, both wearing crowns. The woman is standing, supporting the child with one arm and holding an orb with the other. She has soft facial features, long hair, and is wearing a flowing robe and veil. The child has similar features and is seated on the woman's arm. Both have halos of light around them, and the background features angels with wings amidst clouds.

artworks.title: The Crucifixion
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crucifixion scene. The drawing features a figure affixed to a cross, with arms outstretched and a cloth draped around the waist. The composition is detailed with precise line work, showcasing the anatomy and expression of the central figure. The cross has decorative elements at the top and ends of the horizontal beam, which contain small iconographic images. The background is a simple arch shape filled with lined shading, adding depth to the image. The artist’s signature is inscribed at the bottom left corner.

artworks.title: Saints Peter and Paul
artworks.description: The image displays two individuals standing upright in full-length facing forward. The person on the left holds a book and keys, has curly hair, a beard, and wears flowing robes with a patterned trim. The person on the right has longer curly hair, a long beard, draped robes, and holds a staff. Both individuals have halos around their heads. The background has horizontal lines, creating a textured effect, and the setting is framed by an arch-like border.
